name: Burrata Pugliese
short_description: Fresh burrata with a creamy centre and delicate milk sweetness.
detail_description: Made in Puglia with a soft mozzarella shell and rich stracciatella centre. Serve with tomatoes, basil, and a drizzle of olive oil.

name: Marinated Nocellara Olives
short_description: Buttery green olives marinated with citrus peel and herbs.
detail_description: Large Sicilian Nocellara olives are dressed with lemon, oregano, and extra virgin olive oil. They bring a bright, salty start to an aperitivo board.

name: Caponata Siciliana
short_description: Sweet-sour aubergine relish with capers, celery, and tomato.
detail_description: A Sicilian antipasto of slow-cooked aubergine, tomato, celery, and capers. Spoon onto toasted bread or serve beside grilled fish.

name: Prosciutto di Parma
short_description: Silky cured ham sliced thin for antipasti and sharing boards.
detail_description: Aged Parma ham with gentle sweetness and a clean savoury finish. Layer with melon, figs, or burrata for a classic deli plate.

name: Grilled Artichokes
short_description: Tender artichoke hearts grilled and packed in herb oil.
detail_description: Quartered artichokes are lightly charred, then preserved with parsley, garlic, and olive oil. Add them to antipasti boards, salads, or warm focaccia.

name: Rosemary Focaccia
short_description: Olive oil focaccia with rosemary, sea salt, and a soft open crumb.
detail_description: House focaccia baked with extra virgin olive oil, rosemary, and flaky salt. Serve warm with burrata, olives, caponata, or dipping oil.

name: Finocchiona Salami
short_description: Tuscan fennel salami sliced for antipasti boards and aperitivo.
detail_description: A fragrant cured salami seasoned with fennel seed and black pepper. Layer it with focaccia, pecorino, olives, and house-made drinks.

name: Fresh Tagliatelle
short_description: Egg pasta ribbons cut fresh for rich sauces and quick suppers.
detail_description: Silky tagliatelle made with durum wheat flour and free-range egg. Toss with ragu, mushrooms, or a simple butter and sage sauce.

name: Ricotta and Spinach Ravioli
short_description: Fresh ravioli filled with ricotta, spinach, and nutmeg.
detail_description: Pillowy pasta parcels with a classic ricotta and spinach filling. Finish with tomato sugo, brown butter, or grated pecorino.

name: Beef Ragu Lasagne
short_description: Layered fresh pasta with slow beef ragu and bechamel.
detail_description: A ready-to-bake lasagne built with fresh pasta sheets, long-cooked beef ragu, and creamy bechamel. It is generous enough for two supper portions.

name: Parmigiana di Melanzane
short_description: Aubergine, tomato, basil, and mozzarella baked until bubbling.
detail_description: Slices of aubergine are layered with tomato sugo, mozzarella, basil, and parmesan. Warm it through for a comforting vegetarian primo.

name: Potato Gnocchi
short_description: Soft potato gnocchi ready for sauce, butter, or pesto.
detail_description: Light dumplings made with potato and wheat flour for a simple weeknight primo. Pan-fry after boiling for crisp edges.

name: Pumpkin and Sage Tortelloni
short_description: Fresh tortelloni filled with roasted pumpkin and sage.
detail_description: Large pasta parcels are filled with sweet roasted pumpkin, mascarpone, and sage. Serve with brown butter and toasted hazelnuts.

name: Ribollita Toscana
short_description: Hearty Tuscan vegetable and bread soup with cavolo nero and beans.
detail_description: A rustic ribollita made with cannellini beans, cavolo nero, tomato, vegetables, and torn bread for body. Warm gently and finish with olive oil for a comforting primo.

name: Tiramisu Cup
short_description: Classic tiramisu layered in a ready-to-serve dessert cup.
detail_description: Mascarpone cream, espresso-soaked sponge, and cocoa are layered in an individual cup. It is chilled, balanced, and ready for a dinner finish.

name: Cannoli Siciliani
short_description: Crisp pastry shells filled with sweet ricotta and pistachio.
detail_description: Two Sicilian cannoli filled shortly before packing so the shells stay crisp. Ricotta cream, citrus zest, and pistachio make them bright and rich.

name: Torta della Nonna
short_description: Tuscan custard tart slice with pine nuts and a crisp pastry shell.
detail_description: A classic torta della nonna with vanilla-scented pastry cream, buttery shortcrust, and toasted pine nuts. Serve with espresso or alongside after-dinner drinks.

name: Cantucci Biscotti
short_description: Crunchy almond biscotti for coffee, dessert plates, and gifting.
detail_description: Classic Tuscan cantucci baked crisp with toasted almonds and a gentle citrus note. Serve with espresso or alongside gelato-style desserts.

name: Homemade Aranciata
short_description: Homemade sparkling aranciata with a gently bitter citrus finish.
detail_description: A chilled house-made aranciata with bright orange flavour and fine bubbles. Serve cold with salty antipasti or a casual lunch.

name: Homemade Limonata
short_description: Crisp sparkling limonata with sharp Sicilian lemon character.
detail_description: A refreshing lemon soda with lively acidity and a clean finish. Serve cold with pastries, picnic food, or a light antipasto.

name: Chianti Classico
short_description: Medium-bodied Tuscan red wine with cherry and savoury spice.
detail_description: A food-friendly Chianti with red cherry, dried herbs, and gentle tannins. Pour with lasagne, cured meats, or tomato-led primi.

name: Pinot Grigio delle Venezie
short_description: Crisp white wine with pear, citrus, and a clean mineral finish.
detail_description: A dry Pinot Grigio from the Veneto with bright orchard fruit and gentle acidity. Serve chilled with antipasti, seafood-style primi, or picnic dishes.

name: Sugo al Pomodoro
short_description: Slow tomato sugo with basil for pasta, gnocchi, and bakes.
detail_description: Italian tomatoes are cooked down with olive oil, basil, and a little garlic. Keep a jar ready for fresh pasta or a quick parmigiana.

name: Pesto Genovese
short_description: Basil pesto with pine nuts, parmesan, and extra virgin olive oil.
detail_description: A fragrant Ligurian-style pesto for tossing through pasta or spooning over vegetables. The jar is sized for two generous pasta suppers.

name: Extra Virgin Olive Oil
short_description: Peppery extra virgin olive oil for finishing and dipping.
detail_description: A balanced Italian olive oil with grassy aroma and a clean peppery finish. Use it for bread, salads, vegetables, and final drizzles.

name: Pecorino Toscano
short_description: Firm Tuscan sheep's cheese with a nutty savoury finish.
detail_description: A wedge of Pecorino Toscano for shaving over pasta, serving with salumi, or pairing with honey and fruit. It brings a salty, nutty note to boards and pantry suppers.
